'''Chef Jessen''' is a [[human]] quest giver located in [[Southshore]] in the [[Hillsbrad Foothills]]. Back in his younger days, Jessen used to travel past [[Dalaran]] and to [[Lordamere Lake]] to hunt [[Snapjaw]]s and prepare his world-famous [[Soothing Turtle Bisque]].<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|31|Soothing Turtle Bisque (Alliance)|Soothing Turtle Bisque|profession=Cooking}}</ref>
